svg.text: Each well counts in its first spud year. The numerator counts wells with an initial
completion approval by the file date. Recent cohorts have shorter follow up. A blank means
no wells of this type were first drilled in that band and year. Hollow markers show
partial 2026 through 23 November 2026. Means end in 2025. Blank annual values: 2021 Under
to 500 m, 2026 100 to 500 m. A zero denominator leaves 7 annual values blank. The chart
omits those points and any mean requiring them. The interactive year table identifies the
